verdict.rationale: Interactive, explorable documentation is a fair axis for a package manager and build tool, so it applies. However, the evidence shows only a static CLI command reference with console examples, and all OpenAPI/Swagger probes returned 404. The `nix repl` evaluation environment is an adjacent feature, not an interactive API reference with runnable examples, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
